# llm-judge

> LLM-as-judge with versioned rubrics, strict per-criterion score parsing with one bounded re-ask, and quadratic weighted kappa calibration Python package `trysac-llm-judge`, import name `llm_judge`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
